paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.32% on average, with S&P 500 strongest (-0.23%) and Euro Stoxx 50 weakest (-2.15%). Brent crude changed -4.79% to 88.68. Gold changed -3.53% to 3,727.8. Bitcoin changed -4.14% to 62,210.25. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.066%, a relative move of -0.73%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (-6.96%) and Glencore (-6.11%) moved the most.
